rows.section: Who this applies to
rows.rule: Same taxpayer, same profits/gains, paid/payable foreign and Gibraltar tax, proof satisfactory to Commissioner.
quotes: who proves to the satisfaction of the Commissioner
in respect of the same profits or gains,
shall be entitled to relief from taxation under this Act paid or payable by him

rows.section: Who this applies to
rows.rule: Relief capped at lesser Gibraltar tax on those profits and foreign income tax.
quotes: an amount equal to the lesser of the two following amounts-
the taxation under this Act in respect of the said profits or gains,
the income tax in the other country, territory or jurisdiction in respect of that income.

rows.section: Who this applies to
rows.rule: Foreign tax must be similar basis/nature, not merely named tax.
quotes: any tax calculated on a similar basis or of a similar nature to the taxation imposed by this Act

rows.section: Who this applies to
rows.rule: Foreign tax paid in country of underlying business revenue; actual source evidence required.
quotes: only to tax paid in a country in, or from, which the revenue generated by the underlying business activity
has arisen.

rows.section: The base > Corporate tax-residence exit: scope and base
rows.rule: No domestic relief for stated Gibraltar-source tax charged abroad solely by residence.
quotes: income accruing in or derived from Gibraltar
only by virtue of the fact that the country in which he is resident for tax purposes charges that income to tax on the basis of his residence

rows.section: Who this applies to
rows.rule: Paid/payable wording in1 versus paid in8 is disclosed, not silently resolved.
quotes: or is liable to pay income tax in the other country
only to tax paid in a country

rows.section: The base > Allocate the Gibraltar tax before applying the cap
rows.rule: Proportionate Gibraltar tax before relief by charged relevant profits/total charged profits.
quotes: the total amount of the taxation paid or payable under this Act for that year (before the deduction of any relief granted under this rule)
as the amount of the said profits or gains charged to taxation
bears to the total amount of the profits or gains

rows.section: The base > Account for relief allowed abroad
rows.rule: Reduce Gibraltar relief by foreign unilateral relief allowable for Gibraltar tax.
quotes: the amount of the relief under this rule shall be reduced by the amount of that relief in the other country

rows.section: The base > Account for relief allowed abroad
rows.rule: Compute foreign tax before foreign unilateral relief; authority certificate receivable in evidence.
quotes: shall be calculated without any reduction
a certificate issued in any particular case by or on behalf of the equivalent
shall be receivable in evidence

rows.section: Deadlines and filing > Claim and adjustment deadlines
rows.rule: Claim not later than six years after assessment-year/accounting-period end.
quotes: Any claim to relief under this rule shall be made not later than 6 years after the end of the year of assessment or accounting period

rows.section: Deadlines and filing > Claim and adjustment deadlines
rows.rule: Special six-year assessment/claim route from completion of all material determinations.
quotes: not later than 6 years from the time when all such assessments, adjustments and other determinations have been made
as are material in determining whether any, and if so what relief falls to be given.

rows.section: Cross-border points > UK treaty: Article 22 coordination
rows.rule: Residence/entitlement/effective-date requirements precede Article22; domestic claim alone insufficient.
quotes: persons who are residents of one or both of the territories.
liable to tax therein by reason of his domicile, residence, place of management, place of incorporation
a benefit under this Agreement shall not be granted

rows.section: Cross-border points > UK treaty: Article 22 coordination
rows.rule: Gibraltar may include UK-taxable income; lesser same-income Gibraltar/UK tax deduction.
quotes: Gibraltar may include in the basis upon which such taxes are imposed the items of income
an amount equal to the lesser of the Gibraltar tax due under the laws of Gibraltar or the United Kingdom tax due on that same income

rows.section: Cross-border points > UK treaty: Article 22 coordination
rows.rule: Paragraph1 excluded when UK charge permitted solely by UK resident derivation.
quotes: The provisions of paragraph (1) shall not apply
solely because the income referred to in that paragraph is also income, profits or chargeable gains derived by a resident of the United Kingdom.

rows.section: Cross-border points > UK treaty: Article 22 coordination
rows.rule: Subject to UK law; Gibraltar tax in accordance with agreement, same profits, underlying dividend profits initially excluded.
quotes: Subject to the provisions of the law of the United Kingdom
Gibraltar tax payable under the laws of Gibraltar and in accordance with this Agreement
excluding in the case of a dividend tax payable in respect of the profits out of which the dividend is paid

rows.section: Cross-border points > UK treaty: Article 22 coordination
rows.rule: Company dividend/PEprofit exemptions only when UK exemption applies and UK conditions met.
quotes: shall be exempted from United Kingdom tax when the exemption is applicable and the conditions for exemption under the law of the United Kingdom are met;

rows.section: Cross-border points > UK treaty: Article 22 coordination
rows.rule: Non-exempt corporate dividend; recipient controls at least 10% of voting power, directly/indirectly.
quotes: controls directly or indirectly at least 10 per cent of the voting power
shall also take into account the Gibraltar tax payable by the company in respect of its profits out of which such dividend is paid.

rows.section: Cross-border points > UK treaty: Article 22 coordination
rows.rule: Income UK resident owns that Gibraltar may treaty-tax deemed Gibraltar-source for paragraph 2.
quotes: profits, income and gains owned by a resident of the United Kingdom which may be taxed in Gibraltar
shall be deemed to arise from sources in Gibraltar.

rows.section: Cross-border points > UK treaty: Article 22 coordination
rows.rule: Paragraph2 excluded for stated sole Gibraltar resident-derivation charge.
quotes: The provisions of paragraph (2) shall not apply
solely because the income, profits or chargeable gains referred to in that paragraph is also income derived by a resident of Gibraltar.

rows.section: The base > Corporate tax-residence exit: scope and base
rows.rule: Defined taxpayer gate; this is corporate/PE-specific, not a general individual departure tax.
quotes: “taxpayer” means an ordinarily resident company which has assessable income under the provisions of this Act
or a permanent establishment of any such company resident in the United Kingdom, a Member State of the European Union or a third country;

rows.section: The base > Corporate tax-residence exit: scope and base
rows.rule: Ceasing Gibraltar tax residence and acquiring foreign residence; facts must be established.
quotes: a taxpayer ceases to be resident for tax purposes in Gibraltar, whilst acquiring tax residence in a Member State of the European Union or third country;

rows.section: The base > Corporate tax-residence exit: scope and base
rows.rule: UK / EU / third-country transfer, excluding assets effectively connected with a Gibraltar PE.
quotes: a taxpayer transfers its tax residence to the United Kingdom, a Member State of the European Union or to a third country
except for those assets which remain effectively connected with a permanent establishment in Gibraltar;

rows.section: The base > Corporate tax-residence exit: scope and base
rows.rule: Market value at exit minus tax value for assets otherwise producing assessable income; actuals24rate, not universal rate.
quotes: at the rates set in accordance with section 24 of this Act
market value of the transferred assets which would otherwise produce assessable income
at the time of exit of the assets, less their value for tax purposes.

rows.section: The base > Corporate tax-residence exit: scope and base
rows.rule: Willing unrelated buyers/sellers in direct transaction, not presumed accounting value.
quotes: between willing unrelated buyers and sellers in a direct transaction.

rows.section: Cross-border points > Conditional exit-tax deferral and later changes
rows.rule: Over five years, conditional listed residence-transfer destinations; not equal annual instalments inferred.
quotes: by paying it in instalments over five years
where a taxpayer transfers its tax residence to the United Kingdom, a Member State of the European Union or to a third country that is party to the EEA Agreement;

rows.section: Cross-border points > Conditional exit-tax deferral and later changes
rows.rule: EEA third-country deferral requires mutual tax-recovery-assistance agreement.
quotes: third countries that are party to the EEA Agreement if they have concluded an agreement
on the mutual assistance for the recovery of tax claims.

rows.section: Cross-border points > Conditional exit-tax deferral and later changes
rows.rule: Commissioner may require guarantee for demonstrable actual non-recovery risk.
quotes: there is a demonstrable and actual risk of non-recovery
provide a guarantee as a condition for deferring the payment

rows.section: Cross-border points > Conditional exit-tax deferral and later changes
rows.rule: Immediate debt recovery on specified disposal, subsequent transfer, insolvency/winding-up.
quotes: the deferral of payment shall be immediately discontinued and the tax debt becomes recoverable
sold or otherwise disposed of;
subsequently transferred to a third country;
goes bankrupt or becomes insolvent or is wound up;

rows.section: Cross-border points > Conditional exit-tax deferral and later changes
rows.rule: Failure to correct over reasonable period no more than 12 months; not automatic grace period.
quotes: fails to honour its obligations in relation to the instalments
does not correct its situation over a reasonable period of time, which shall not exceed 12 months.

rows.section: Cross-border points > Conditional exit-tax deferral and later changes
rows.rule: EEA recovery-agreement exception confined to6(b)/(c).
quotes: Subparagraph (6)(b) and (c) shall not apply to third countries that are party to the EEA Agreement
if they have concluded an agreement
on the mutual assistance for the recovery of tax claims.

rows.section: Cross-border points > Conditional exit-tax deferral and later changes
rows.rule: UK/EU inbound established value accepted unless not market value; not all-country step-up.
quotes: from the United Kingdom or a European Union Member State outside Gibraltar to Gibraltar
shall accept the value established
unless this does not reflect the market value.

rows.rule: Specified securities/collateral/prudential/liquidity cases; revert to the UK / EU transferor within 12 months.
quotes: assets are set to revert to the United Kingdom or a Member State of the European Union as the transferor within a period of 12 months
financing of securities, assets posted as collateral
prudential capital requirements or for the purpose of liquidity management.

rows.rule: 8Atransfer-assets wording UK / EU losing right versus18A(1)(a)–(b), Gibraltar; unresolved, not rewritten.
